subject: txn: deprecate the transaction auto retry and related statement count limit (#50782)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, scoped to session/sessionctx/executor behavior. The only runtime behavior change in-scope is `@@tidb_disable_txn_auto_retry` now being effectively forced to `ON` (auto-retry disabled) via a SysVar `Validation` hook that emits a deprecation warning when setting `OFF`; other in-scope edits are tests and comments (e.g., `StmtCountLimit` marked deprecated in config). No remaining Blocker/High correctness, transaction/session semantics, or consistency issues found in the touched runtime paths.
